human_delta: Use one Guide conversation surface and stable page plates instead of binding continuity to literal chat instances. Multiple page plates may be referenced in one Guide request; a new combined page gets its own identity/context.
decisions: Every visible page receives permanent AAA000 plate identity distinct from P### change notifications.
Every page has deterministic durable context path even when no literal page chat/context file exists yet; missing file means virtual context, materialized on first material use.

The human talks to /g with one or more plates + natural-language intent; /g resolves exact pages, persists a durable request, then chooses direct execution, planner, parallel workers and/or steward without human routing.
Combining pages preserves parent identities/revisions as provenance. A requested new integrated page receives a new plate/context rather than mutating parent identity by implication.
New-page publication requires plate reservation, context creation, candidate build, verification, publication, exact revision, registry entry and P### visible change note before normal Live exposure.
Page request/plate/registry mutation follows create-if-absent + PIN/claim + CAS/reload laws; duplicate contenders converge rather than minting variants.
